sources.title: Drama 3 - Direct Every Line of AI Voice | Fish Audio
sources.snippet: Drama 3 is Fish Audio's directable text-to-speech model. Describe the performance in your own words, add sounds and pauses where you want them, and control exactly which words change.

sources.title: Drama 3 - Fish Audio
sources.snippet: Drama 3 is our latest text-to-speech model built for voice direction and content creation. Alongside your script, you describe how each line should be performed, add sounds and pauses, and limit a delivery to specific words.

sources.title: Drama 3 - AI Model | There's An AI For That
sources.snippet: Drama 3 is Fish Audio's most controllable text to speech model, letting developers direct AI voice performances using natural language instead of markup tags. It supports mid sentence voice shifts, multi character scene generation in one pass, and single word regeneration that preserves surrounding audio.

sources.title: Drama 3 API, Pricing & Playground | Vercel AI Gateway
sources.snippet: Drama 3 Drama 3 is Fish Audio's text-to-speech model, currently in preview, that lets you direct voice performances using natural-language instructions. It supports control over emotion, pacing, pauses, and vocal sounds, with tags that apply effects to specific words.

sources.title: Drama 3 - API Pricing & Benchmarks | OpenRouter
sources.snippet: Drama 3 is a text-to-speech model from Fish Audio built for directed voice performances. You write the direction in plain language in square brackets before a line, such as [nervous, barely holding it together], and can add sounds and pauses inline or change the delivery of specific words with paired tags like <whisper>.
